M09_disposition.original: Preserve frozen M09 unchanged and under investigation, not a validated new method. Its original 300-trial/Spearman/calibrated-rejection protocol was not executed.
M09_disposition.v2: Explicit prospective refinement executed; consensus-switch excess fails its declared incremental-discrimination gate. Retain the full-support interaction as an unconfirmed lead, not a promoted endpoint.
M09_disposition.interpretation: Failure to establish benefit here neither proves universal equivalence to linear propagation nor rules out useful nonlinear regimes.

scientific_findings.finding: Three observed problems are real within the inspected records, but do not identify a common cause.
scientific_findings.evidence: Tracking: 293/1858 and 15/1001 frames meet exploratory low-residual/high-error criteria. InfoGeo: two selected native DINOv2 patch descriptors have cosine 0.93599 and the same target maximum; all three inspected query identities rank first. Cross-domain SIFT: 62 matches, only 1 nominal-geometry-consistent, no pose.
scientific_findings.interpretation: Tracking drift, correspondence errors and map bias remain competing explanations. Unreviewed point annotations prohibit formal PCK. A post-pose uncertainty diagnostic cannot repair the unsolved cross-domain case.

scientific_findings.finding: A real correspondence-based intervention ran, not merely an algebraic identity check.
scientific_findings.evidence: Actual SIFT pixels and DSM lifting feed RANSAC and LM. All 120 designed cases solve; 64 exceed 1 m camera-centre error. No failed probes; positive-depth fraction is 1.
scientific_findings.interpretation: Images and matches are real; injected height errors are synthetic; truth is reconstruction-derived, not surveyed external-DSM truth.

scientific_findings.finding: Consensus-associated excess exists but does not add pooled discrimination.
A support-dependent lead survives, without confirmation.
scientific_findings.evidence: Full support: excess AUROC 0.9023 versus best ordinary 0.8308; random55 0.7375; concentrated55 0.6347.
scientific_findings.interpretation: No retrospective subgroup promotion. At amplitude 2 m, excess AUROC 0.9565 uses only one negative; smaller-amplitude results are much weaker.

scientific_findings.finding: Distinct, significant contribution is not established by the available prior art and measurements.
scientific_findings.evidence: JCGM101:2008 sections 5.8-5.9 establish numerical nonlinear propagation; Vakhitov et al. section 3.5 models 2D and 3D uncertainty in PnP refinement; Chen et al. sections 3.1-3.2 address non-Gaussian pose ambiguity and Monte Carlo integration.
scientific_findings.interpretation: These sources invalidate broad novelty claims about perturbation propagation or uncertainty-aware PnP, but do not prove exact equivalence to the proposed full-minus-fixed diagnostic. Its practical incremental value remains unsupported.

invalid_claims_or_errors.issue: Original M09 motivation confuses matching error with reprojection residual.
invalid_claims_or_errors.correction: OrthoLoC Table 6 reports SP+LG matching error 2.5/2.5 px but reprojection error 3.4/9.0 px. Tracking records, not that table, support the new low-residual/high-error motivation.

invalid_claims_or_errors.issue: Analytic baseline is not an exact-Hessian covariance calculation.
invalid_claims_or_errors.correction: It computes a Gauss-Newton implicit camera-centre sensitivity and maximum column norm, without forming propagated covariance. Nominal fixed-consensus finite-difference discrepancies are 0.00583, 0.00583 and 0.01232; corrupted-state accuracy is not separately checked.

invalid_claims_or_errors.issue: Published-method and original-protocol coverage must not be overstated.
invalid_claims_or_errors.correction: No Vakhitov covariance-weighted estimator or EProPnP posterior/training implementation exists here. MC16 is a spherical-probe maximum, not calibrated posterior uncertainty. finite_full is an operationalized v2 comparator, not literal execution of original M09.

invalid_claims_or_errors.issue: Mechanistic isolation and uncertainty statements have boundaries.
invalid_claims_or_errors.correction: Full and fixed solves differ in initialization as well as consensus. Near-zero unchanged-consensus excess supports, but does not prove, pure consensus causation. cv2.setRNGSeed may not alter PnPRansac internal sampling: zero spread demonstrates this API control only, not independent hypothesis streams. The bootstrap fixes the empirically selected strongest baseline; it is not a simultaneous comparison.

experimental_limits: One solvable same-domain scene; cross-domain failure is retained, not an uncertainty success.
Eight perturbation blocks and 99 unique input geometries, not 120 independent scenes. Twenty-four zero-amplitude rows repeat three geometries/labels; MC probes still vary.
Conditional bootstrap only; no scene-generalization inference.
Pooling amplitude regimes changes ranking: residual AUROC is 0.7838 pooled but 0.1944/0.1259 at amplitudes 0.25/0.5.
Support-specific QR bases mean shared coefficients do not impose identical physical fields across supports; support contrasts do not isolate concentration.
DC height is a universal translation gauge; no calibrated abstention or real-map causal attribution is demonstrated.
No exhaustive novelty search; original tracker, feature models and full experiment were not rerun.

selection_audit_summary.deep_sample: M02 normalization/depth defects are genuine. M11 residual space is 2N-dimensional; DCT composition is valid, but DC makes the proposed unrestricted gain degenerate. M12 query-constant CSLS omission preserves ranking; exposure-adjusted hubness controls remain necessary.
selection_audit_summary.judgment: Selection optimality is unproved. Missing experiments do not establish nonnovelty. Preserve M11 bias/visibility, M02 support and M12 retrieval hypotheses without treating them as established explanations. M06/M08 remain rejected under the user's separate disposition; this audit does not reinstate them.

verification.tasks_A_to_E: A: specified v2 checked; B: all nine and deep three reviewed; C: three recorded failure patterns inspected; D: real experiment and statistics verified; E: independent no-contribution decision.
verification.checks: Protocol, implementation, matching-report and correspondence-cache hashes match. Independently recomputed all pooled AUROCs by rank sums, labels, factorial completeness and 2000 paired-block bootstrap replicates. Read closest-prior-art and exact-retrieval packets; decisive primary passages were also inspected directly.

next_scientific_action: Freeze a separate, independent-scene test of absorbed map bias versus residual-visible mismatch (M11-v2), with DC separated, common physical perturbation fields and count-matched supports. Test the full-support interaction prospectively against residual, inlier fraction, GN sensitivity and nonlinear propagation; do not promote M09 meanwhile.
